title: The Little Pup Who Raced Ahead: Waiting Your Turn!

lines.text: Sunny Saturday at the playground! The giant curly red slide was the main attraction!
lines.caps: Sunny day at the *PLAYGROUND! | The giant curly slide was the *MAIN | *ATTRACTION!

lines.text: A neat line of ducklings, kittens, and bunnies stood waiting patiently!
lines.caps: A neat line of *FRIENDS | stood waiting patiently for their *TURN!

lines.text: ZOOM! Buster the puppy charged forward, pushed past the kittens, and raced up the ladder!
lines.caps: *ZOOM! Buster charged forward, | pushed past the kittens, and climbed the *LADDER!

lines.text: Me first, me first! Buster barked, sliding down with a proud grin!
lines.caps: Me first, *ME FIRST! | Buster barked, sliding down with a *PROUD | *GRIN!

lines.text: When he reached the bottom, nobody was cheering. His friends folded their arms and walked away!
lines.caps: At the bottom, nobody *CHEERED. | His friends folded their arms and *WALKED | *AWAY!

lines.text: Buster sat alone by the slide. Flying down is boring when no one is playing with you!
lines.caps: Buster sat alone. *SLIDING | is boring when no one plays with *YOU!

lines.text: Buster walked over and apologized: I'm sorry for cutting. I'll wait my turn!
lines.caps: Buster apologized: I'm *SORRY | for cutting. I'll wait my *TURN!

lines.text: Patience and fair play turn simple playground slides into shared happiness!
lines.caps: Patience and fair *PLAY | turn playground slides into shared *HAPPINESS!

lines.text: Play fair and stay kind—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
